title: Windows run() uses shell:true, so caxa path arguments are split on spaces and parsed by cmd.exe
test: tests/packageApp.test.js (14 new tests): 'run passes path arguments with spaces and cmd.exe metacharacters to the child unchanged', 'run passes them unchanged through a .cmd shim built like npm.cmd', 'run passes them unchanged to a .cmd shim found by its bare name through PATH', 'run still throws "<command> failed with code <status>" when the child exits non-zero', 'caxa started the Windows way receives a path with spaces, & ^ ( ), % and ! as one argument', 'npm ci started the Windows way keeps its flags and runs in a stage directory with spaces and & ( ) in its path', 'off Windows buildPackagerCommand returns the command and arguments as given, without a shell', 'on Windows npm ci runs as node plus npm_execpath, with no shell and its flags unchanged', 'on Windows an npm_execpath that is not npm's own CLI is not used to run npm ci', 'on Windows caxa runs as node plus its bin script, each path one argument, the -- and {{caxa}} placeholders verbatim', 'the Windows cmd.exe fallback double-quotes every argument, so spaces and & | ^ ( ) stay inside one argument', 'the Windows cmd.exe fallback refuses ", %, ! and line breaks instead of escaping them', 'getCaxaBinPath finds the bin caxa's package.json names, and node runs it as the caxa CLI', 'getCaxaBinPath walks past a nested package.json to caxa's own, reads an object bin, and says when caxa is missing'
proof: The defect, on this Windows host (Node 22.14.0), with the unchanged run() (only added to module.exports): run('node', [probe, 'C:\\Users\\A B\\proj & x\\.caxa-stage', 'C:\\Users\\A B\\proj & x\\Nextra.exe', 'C:\\Users\\A B\\AppData\\Local\\Temp (1)\\a^b|c\\nextra-caxa-stub-42.exe', '--', '{{caxa}}/server.js']) made the child receive 2 arguments, 'C:\\Users\\A' and 'B\\proj'; cmd.exe ran the fragments after & and | as commands ('The system cannot find the path specified.' twice) and run() threw 'node failed with code 255' (script .arbitra/dev-notes/results/TASK-047-repro.js.txt, output in TASK-047-before.txt). The committed tests on the unchanged code: 60 tests, 48 pass, 12 fail; the three run() tests failed for the issue's reason ('C:\\Program Files\\nodejs\\node.exe failed with code 255' because the node path itself was split, the .cmd shim in 'A B (1) & x' likewise, and a child exiting 3 was reported as code 1), the nine others with 'buildPackagerCommand is not a function' / 'getCaxaBinPath is not a function'. Two tests were added after the fix: the getCaxaBinPath walk test and the bare-name PATH shim test; the latter fails when the command name is quoted (checked by mutating commandForCmd). After the fix: the file passes 62/62, the same reproduction delivers all 5 arguments unchanged (TASK-047-after.txt), real caxa started as node plus its bin reports the exact --input path containing spaces, &, ^, (, ), % and ! and stops before doing any work, a stand-in npm-cli.js receives 'ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund' in a stage directory 'A B (1) & x', and version-only checks of the real routes worked: node + npm-cli.js --version, the cmd.exe fallback 'npm --version' (through npm.cmd), and run('npx', ['caxa', '--version']) printed 3.0.1. Not done: the approval-gated packaging run (node scripts/package-app.js from a folder whose path has a space, expecting Nextra.exe and Nextra.exe.sha256); the brief forbids running the packager (it runs npm ci and downloads cloudflared and FFmpeg).
